pages.title: Power% - the Combo Budget
pages.text: Every hit in a combo reduces your {term:Power%} - EFZ's proration system. The lower it drops, the shorter the juggle time each following hit gets, until nothing connects anymore. A combo is a budget: every hit spends some of it.

pages.title: Damage Efficiency
pages.text: Good routes maximize damage-per-proration: strong hits that spend little budget. Long flashy routes are not automatically better - a stable route that always lands beats an optimal one you drop half the time.

pages.title: Reading the Power Readout
pages.text: One trap: the Power% number on screen is always ONE HIT BEHIND - it shows the value when the previous hit connected. Combos stop working at their break point, so watch the readout and learn where your route stops connecting.
